sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (8 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes:
Three ledger lines were examined for VANGL1 (524 aa, 4-TM topology). VANGL1 has no signal peptide; its N-terminus (residue 1, M) is intracellular (topology I, residues 1–112), and its C-terminus (residue 524, V) is also intracellular (topology I, residues 242–524). The two extracellular loops are ECL1 (residues 134–151) and ECL2 (residues 207–218).

Ledger line 1 (PMC11698883): C-terminal eGFP + strep tag fused to full-length human VANGL1 via a 3C site. The C-terminus is intracellular — this is an intracellular terminus tag, not an extracellular one. Does NOT qualify.

Ledger line 2 (PMC11698883): GFP-tagged full-length VANGL1 evaluated by FSEC. This is the same C-terminal construct as line 1, confirming expression and homogeneity. Does NOT qualify for the same reason.

Ledger line 3 (PMC11698917): N-terminal GFP tag on full-length human VANGL1 cloned into pEG BacMan. The N-terminus (residue 1) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. This is an intracellular terminus tag. Does NOT qualify.

No ledger line reports a tag insertion on an extracellular face of VANGL1 — neither in ECL1 (134–151), ECL2 (207–218), nor any extracellular terminus. Zero sites qualify.
